_notes: Stranglethorn cave boss and named-rare loot (2026-10-29). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3. Budget checked by audit() in tools/build_stranglethorn_cave_content.py. Rares are never quested, and nothing here carries magic resistance (floor is level 45).

Rootmaw.name: Rootmaw's Drag-Tooth
Rootmaw.flavor_text: It does not bite to kill. It bites to carry you to the drain.

Rootmaw.name: Sunken Bole Stave
Rootmaw.flavor_text: Root, not wood. The difference matters to whoever has to hold it.

Rootmaw.name: Sinkwader Boots
Rootmaw.flavor_text: Everyone who comes out of the Hollow comes out wet to the knee.

Rootmaw.name: Outflow Warden's Hauberk
Rootmaw.flavor_text: The water leaves the crag here and it has to get past something to do it.

Hap'ka the Drowned.name: Stairfall Maul
Hap'ka the Drowned.flavor_text: Zul'Marosh has a stair and the bottom of it is under water.

Hap'ka the Drowned.name: Hap'ka's Rotted Longbow
Hap'ka the Drowned.flavor_text: The stave held. Everything that was wrapped around it did not.

Hap'ka the Drowned.name: Drowned Shelf Wrappings
Hap'ka the Drowned.flavor_text: Still laced the way he laced them, and still on him.

Hap'ka the Drowned.name: Nobody-Came-Down Greaves
Hap'ka the Drowned.flavor_text: They knew where he fell. That was never the problem.

Veilspeaker Zul'Rath.name: Veilspeaker's Spray-Rod
Veilspeaker Zul'Rath.flavor_text: He argues with the waterfall daily and has not lost yet.

Veilspeaker Zul'Rath.name: Terracekeeper's Glaive
Veilspeaker Zul'Rath.flavor_text: Long enough to reach the terrace below without going down to it.

Veilspeaker Zul'Rath.name: Mistcaller's Shroud
Veilspeaker Zul'Rath.flavor_text: It has not been properly dry since it was made.

Veilspeaker Zul'Rath.name: Shrinekeeper's Spaulders
Veilspeaker Zul'Rath.flavor_text: Carved on the inside, where the keeper can see it and nobody else can.

Sheetfall.name: Standing Column Bulwark
Sheetfall.flavor_text: It holds its shape for about as long as you need it not to.

Sheetfall.name: Lipwater Jerkin
Sheetfall.flavor_text: Cut for someone who works where the floor is always running.

Sheetfall.name: Plungewrought Legplates
Sheetfall.flavor_text: Water falling this far does the hammering for you.

Sheetfall.name: Coif of the Fourth Terrace
Sheetfall.flavor_text: The lowest one. You hear the pool before you can see over the edge.

Tide-Priestess Myzrai.name: Myzrai's Court Blade
Tide-Priestess Myzrai.flavor_text: Naga work over troll stone. Neither of them asked the other.

Tide-Priestess Myzrai.name: Vestments of the Taken Court
Tide-Priestess Myzrai.flavor_text: Cut to the old pattern, by someone who had seen the old pattern.

Tide-Priestess Myzrai.name: Terrace-Walker's Treads
Tide-Priestess Myzrai.flavor_text: The dry ground down here is two spans wide and it is the only road.

Tide-Priestess Myzrai.name: Sanctum Guard's Pauldrons
Tide-Priestess Myzrai.flavor_text: Salt gets into the joints of everything and then stays there.

Tide-Priestess Myzrai.name: Hall-Keeper's Legguards
Tide-Priestess Myzrai.flavor_text: Cut heavy at the thigh, for standing in moving water without being moved.

Saltgorge.name: Saltgorge Hide Mantle
Saltgorge.flavor_text: It lives in a hall with a roof on it and comes out at the doorway.

Saltgorge.name: Deep Hall Chain
Saltgorge.flavor_text: Whoever wore it last went into the water in it.

Saltgorge.name: Brinelogged Girdle
Saltgorge.flavor_text: Heavy, and it does not get lighter as it dries, because it does not dry.

Saltgorge.name: Courtyard Sabatons
Saltgorge.flavor_text: Stone, water, stone. You can hear somebody coming the length of the terrace.

Saltgorge.name: Doorway-Watcher's Grips
Saltgorge.flavor_text: Something held the jamb hard enough to leave the shape of its hand in it.
